history.summary: A 2024 99-yr leasehold compact 1BR at One Pearl Bank (D03 Outram), 431 sqft at $1.0M / $2,320 psf, 480m from Outram Park triple-line interchange. At $2,320 psf it is ~11% below the $2,601 median and near the bottom of the project's $2,279–$3,828 range — a rare sub-$1M entry into prime D03 with a 390-txn-deep, highly liquid 774-unit development. Flat post-TOP resale appreciation (0.0%) is the main caveat.
history.rating_rationale: $2,320 psf is ~11% under the $2,601 URA median and at the low end of the verified $2,279–$3,828 transacting range — genuine value for a 2024 unit. $1.0M absolute entry into prime D03 is rare and keeps the studio in a deep, liquid band; Outram Park (NEL/EWL/TEL interchange, ~480m), SGH medical hub and the Greater Southern Waterfront drive durable rental demand. Reliable 390-txn data confirms liquidity; the 0.0% resale-only appreciation reflects normal post-completion plateau rather than weakness, and 431sqft is the niche compact-studio segment.

99-yr leasehold; new-launch bias still in the headline rate
